name: nativescript-preferences-workspace
description: Development workspace for nativescript-preferences. The publishable package lives in ./src, the demo app in ./demo.

scripts.build: cd src && npm install && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: cd src && npm install && npm run typecheck
scripts.demo.build: npm --prefix demo run build.android && npm --prefix demo run build.ios
scripts.test: cd src && npm install && npm test
